Regular City Council Meeting - no video - audio only available in the City Clerk's Department
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
June 14, 2011
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Reverend Brian Anderson of the Center for Spiritual Discovery
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Recognition of Outgoing Crime and Substance Abuse Prevention Commissioner Bill Krunglevich
P2.
Certificates to Annual Appointments to Commissions, Boards, and Committees and Certificates to Outgoing Commission and Committee Members
P3.
Letters of Recognition to the Sheriff's Explorer Deputies
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for the Month Ending April 30, 2011 (CC)
C4.
Woman's Club of Vista Donation (CC)
C5.
Accepting Previously Rejected Offers of Dedication Maps 14578 and 15538 (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- , Map 14578; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- , Map 15538.
C6.
Adoption of the Appropriation Limit for Fiscal Year 2011/2012 (CC)
C7.
As-Needed Geotechnical Engineering Services Agreements (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- , with Ninyo & Moore;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- , with Vinje & Middleton, Inc.;
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- , with West Coast Geotechnical Consultants, Inc.; and
4.
Authorize the Mayor to execute the three agreements.
C8.
Encina Wastewater Authority Budget for Fiscal Year 2011/2012 (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- .
2.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2011- .
C9.
Operations Funding Advance Agreement (CC/CDC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- .
2.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2011- .
C10.
Supplemental Agreement with the Vista Fire Protection District (CC)
C11.
Utility Billing Auditing Services Agreement (CC)
C12.
Unscheduled Vacancy on the Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Citizens Advisory Committee (CC)
C13.
Cisco SMARTnet Service Renewal (CC)
C14.
Fair Housing Services (CC)
C15.
Stormwater Consulting Services Amendment (CC)
C16.
Traffic Engineering Consultant Amendment (CC)
C17.
Unclaimed Trust Deposits (CC)
C18.
State Revolving Fund - Sewer Loan Repayment Authorizations and Amendment to Carlsbad Agreement (CC/BSD)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , pledging net revenue from Vista Sewer operating revenues for Clean Water State Revolving Funding Program of the State Water Resources Control Board;
2.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2011- , pledging net revenue from Buena Sanitation District operating revenues for Clean Water State Revolving Funding Program of the State Water Resources Control Board; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving the First Amendment to the Vista/Carlsbad Interceptor Ownership, Operation and Maintenance Agreement with Carlsbad.
C19.
Labor Relations Agreements with Vista City Maintenance Association (VCMA), Vista City Employee Association (VCEA), Vista Fire Fighter Association (VFFA), and Management and Confidential Employee Compensation Plan Amendments (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving a Settlement Agreement between the City of Vista and VCMA;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving a Letter Agreement between the City of Vista and VCEA;
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving a Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Vista and the VFFA; and
4.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , amending the Management and Confidential Employee Compensation Plan.
DISCUSSION
D1.
2011 Community Development Commission Tax Allocation Bond Issuance (CC/CDC/JPFA)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving the issuance by the Community Development Commission of the City of Vista of not to exceed $16,500,000 principal amount of Tax Allocation Bonds to provide financing for the Vista Redevelopment Project.
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2011- , authorizing the issuance and sale of not to exceed $16,500,000 principal amount of Tax Allocation Bonds relating to the Vista Redevelopment Project, approving related documents and authorizing official actions.
3.
Adopt Vista Joint Powers Financing Authority Resolution No. 2011- , authorizing the purchase and sale of 2011 Tax Allocation Bonds (tax exempt) relating to the Vista Redevelopment Project, approving related documents and authorizing official actions.
D2.
Fiscal Year 2011/12 Operating Budget (CC/CDC/BSD)
1.
Adopt the following resolutions approving the annual Operating Budget for Fiscal Year 2011/12:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- ;
b.
Community Development Commission
Resolution No. 2011- ; and
c.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2011- .
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2011- , finding and determining that the planning and general administrative expenses chargeable to the low and moderate income fund for FY 2011/12 are necessary for the production, improvement or preservation of the low and moderate income housing.
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , amending the city-wide Classification and Compensation Index and repealing all resolutions in conflict herewith.
4.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving City Council Policy No. 200-19, Use of Year-End Fund Balance.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Levy of Delinquent Mandatory Trash Charges for FY 2010/2011 (CC)
1.
Conduct a Public Hearing to receive public testimony regarding delinquent mandatory trash charges, close the Public Hearing; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving liens on assessor's parcels within the City of Vista to be collected with the general property taxes on the FY 2011/12 property tax roll for delinquent refuse collection service fees and collection charges.
PH2.
Collection of Delinquent Sewer Service Charges (CC/BSD)
1.
Conduct a Public Hearing to receive public testimony regarding delinquent sewer service charges, close the Public Hearing; and
2.
Adopt the following resolutions memorializing the sewer service charge for Fiscal Year 2011/12 and approving liens on assessor's parcels within the district to be collected with the general property taxes on the Fiscal Year 2011/12 tax roll for unpaid sewer service charges:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- , in accordance with City Ordinance No. 2008-4.
b.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2011- , in accordance with Buena Sanitation District Ordinance No. 2008-1.
PH3.
Collection of Delinquent 2010 Weed Abatement Charges (CC)
1.
Conduct a Public Hearing to provide an opportunity for each owner of land or other interested person whose parcel is affected by the Fiscal Year 2010-2011 Report of Proceedings and an Account of Costs Incurred to present a written or oral protest or objection to such report and account; close the Public Hearing, and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving and confirming a report and account for abatement of weeds, shrubs, dead trees and waste matter for FY 2010/11.
PH4.
Levy of Delinquent FY 2010/2011 Property Related Administrative Citation Charges (CC)
1.
Conduct a Public Hearing to receive public testimony regarding delinquent property related administrative citation charges, close the Public Hearing; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving liens on assessor's parcels within the City of Vista to be collected with the general property taxes on the fiscal year 2011/12 property tax roll for delinquent property related administrative citations.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
